Title: G-Series instances for Azure Virtual Machines available in Canada Central and Canada East

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Machines customers can take advantage of the G-Series instances now available in Canada Central and Canada East. They feature the latest Intel Xeon processor E5 v3 family and provide unparalleled computational performance, as well as more memory and more local solid-state drive (SSD) storage than any current virtual machine size in the public cloud. So they're ideal for your most demanding applications.

For more information about pricing, please visit the Virtual Machines pricing page.
